name: Southeast Corridor: Cau Dat - Trai Mat - Sao Nam

raw_json.cluster_name: Southeast Corridor: Cau Dat - Trai Mat - Sao Nam
raw_json.terrain_and_road_condition: National Highway 20 with smooth asphalt, moderate slopes, scenic winding curves overlooking the glowing greenhouse valley at night.
raw_json.best_vehicle: Motorbike (scooter or semi-auto both fine) or Taxi/Grab

ideal_timing.early_morning: 04:30 - 07:00: Cloud hunting at Cau Dat, sunrise over the tea hills
ideal_timing.morning: 07:30 - 11:30: Check-in at the Wind Turbines, Trai Mat Station, Linh Phuoc Pagoda
ideal_timing.afternoon: 14:00 - 17:30: Tui Mo To Cafe, Panorama viewpoint, Doi Da Chien
ideal_timing.evening: 18:00 - 21:30: Watch the glowing greenhouse lights of Trai Mat valley

key_places.name: Thien Duong San May Cau Dat (Cloud Hunting Paradise)
key_places.activity: Cloud sea hunting, check-in on the wooden bridge

key_places.name: Linh Phuoc Pagoda (Ve Chai Pagoda)
key_places.activity: Admire the 18-floor mosaic ceramic architecture

key_places.name: Tui Mo To Cafe
key_places.activity: Check-in at the daisy garden and sunset wooden cottage

key_places.name: Hoang Hon BBQ Restaurant
key_places.activity: BBQ dinner in the valley at golden hour

key_places.name: Da Lat Hoang Hon Trai Mat
key_places.activity: Panoramic view of the greenhouse lights valley

suggested_half_day_flow: 05:00: Head out for cloud hunting at Cau Dat Panorama
07:30: Breakfast - hot banh mi xiu mai at Trai Mat
08:30: Explore the Cau Dat tea hills & Wind Turbines
10:15: Visit Linh Phuoc (Ve Chai) Pagoda
11:45: Lunch at Ga Lung Chung Doi Restaurant
raw_json.ai_clustering_rules: Prioritize scheduling in a single session. DO NOT combine in the same session with the Ta Nung Corridor as they are in opposite directions, ~35km apart.

name: West-Southwest Corridor: Ta Nung Pass - Van Thanh - Me Linh

raw_json.cluster_name: West-Southwest Corridor: Ta Nung Pass - Van Thanh - Me Linh
raw_json.terrain_and_road_condition: Ta Nung Pass with winding hairpin bends and steep drops, smooth asphalt, majestic pine forest scenery.
raw_json.best_vehicle: Semi-auto motorbike (Sirius/Wave) or car with an experienced driver. Scooters require a skilled rider on the downhill.

ideal_timing.morning: 08:00 - 11:30: Play at Puppy Farm, admire flowers at Van Thanh Flower Village
ideal_timing.lunch: 11:30 - 13:00: Grilled hill chicken with bamboo rice at the foot of Ta Nung Pass
ideal_timing.afternoon: 13:30 - 17:00: Me Linh Coffee Garden with valley view, Elephant Waterfall, Linh An Pagoda

key_places.name: Puppy Farm (Nong Trai Cun)
key_places.activity: Play with hundreds of cute puppies, pick high-tech strawberries

key_places.name: Me Linh Coffee Garden
key_places.activity: Enjoy genuine weasel coffee, overlook the vast coffee plantation

key_places.name: Elephant Waterfall & Linh An Pagoda
key_places.activity: Admire the tallest outdoor Guanyin Buddha statue in Vietnam and the majestic waterfall

key_places.name: Hoa Son Dien Trang
key_places.activity: Check-in at the giant Buddha's Hand sculpture in the primeval forest

suggested_half_day_flow: 08:00: Depart along Hoang Van Thu Road past Cam Ly Waterfall
08:30: Explore Puppy Farm & Cherry Tomato Garden
11:00: Check-in at Me Linh Coffee Garden
12:30: Enjoy bamboo rice with grilled chicken
14:00: Visit the giant Guanyin statue at Linh An Pagoda
raw_json.ai_clustering_rules: Follow the downhill route from Van Thanh to the foot of Me Linh Pass to save fuel and ensure safety.

name: North Corridor: Da Phu Hill - Golden Valley - Lonely Pine Tree

raw_json.cluster_name: North Corridor: Da Phu Hill - Golden Valley - Lonely Pine Tree
raw_json.terrain_and_road_condition: Scenic road to Dankia - Suoi Vang Lake is poetic and dreamy. The track to the Lonely Pine Tree is rough red-dirt road (avoid during rainy season).
raw_json.best_vehicle: High-clearance or semi-auto motorbike, or book a jeep/boat service to the grass shore.

ideal_timing.early_morning: 04:30 - 06:30: Cloud hunting and mystical sunrise at Da Phu Hill / Thien Phuc Duc Hill
ideal_timing.morning: 07:30 - 11:30: Picnic at Golden Valley, stroll through the pine forest along Suoi Vang Lake
ideal_timing.afternoon: 14:30 - 17:30: Check-in at Pink Grass Hill (Nov-Dec) & Lonely Pine Tree

key_places.name: Da Phu Hill
key_places.activity: Free-entry premium cloud-hunting spot, camp overnight to stargaze the Milky Way

key_places.name: Thien Phuc Duc Hill
key_places.activity: Lone pine tree with a direct view of Langbiang peak

key_places.name: Golden Valley (Thung Lung Vang) Resort
key_places.activity: Crystal-clear lake, bonsai garden, and ancient pine forest

key_places.name: Cu Lan Village
key_places.activity: Experience jeep river-crossing, discover K'Ho ethnic minority culture

suggested_half_day_flow: 04:45: Cloud hunting at dawn on Da Phu Hill
07:30: Breakfast on the way back
09:00: Leisurely walk at Golden Valley
11:30: Picnic lunch or dine at the sturgeon stream restaurant
raw_json.ai_clustering_rules: Best suited for travel_style: 'Explorer' and 'Trekking'. Strictly warn guests NOT to ride scooters to the Lonely Pine Tree when the road is wet.

name: South Corridor: Tuyen Lam Lake - Datanla Waterfall - Prenn Pass

raw_json.cluster_name: South Corridor: Tuyen Lam Lake - Datanla Waterfall - Prenn Pass
raw_json.terrain_and_road_condition: Prenn Pass newly upgraded to 4 lanes, extremely smooth. The road around Tuyen Lam Lake is shaded by lush green pines.
raw_json.best_vehicle: All vehicle types (scooter, car, road bicycle)

ideal_timing.morning: 07:30 - 11:30: Early SUP paddle on the calm lake, Truc Lam Zen Monastery, Datanla Canyoning
ideal_timing.afternoon: 13:30 - 17:30: Clay Sculpting Tunnel, Lavender Dalat, cafe overlooking the lake at The Wilder-nest

key_places.name: Datanla Canyoning & Waterfall Abseiling
key_places.activity: Southeast Asia's longest alpine coaster (2,400m) and 7-tier waterfall abseiling

key_places.name: Truc Lam Zen Monastery & Robin Hill Cable Car
key_places.activity: Cable car ride over the pine forest, meditate in the flower-filled grounds

key_places.name: Clay Sculpting Tunnel & Infinity Pool
key_places.activity: Da Lat history recreated in red basalt clay with a viral two-face statue for photo ops

key_places.name: Tuyen Lam Lake Nature Walk
key_places.activity: Kayak / SUP paddling, camping in the cool pine forest

suggested_half_day_flow: 07:30: Take the cable car from Robin Hill to Truc Lam Monastery
09:00: Experience the New Alpine Coaster at Datanla Waterfall
11:30: Enjoy bamboo-tube grilled chicken rice at Tuyen Lam
13:30: Check-in at the Infinity Pool at the Clay Sculpting Tunnel
15:30: Afternoon tea listening to the pines by the lakeside
raw_json.ai_clustering_rules: The perfect corridor for families and couples who prefer a 'Stay relax' style combined with light 'Adventure'.

name: City Center & Heritage: Xuan Huong Lake - Bao Dai Palace - Historic Churches

raw_json.cluster_name: City Center & Heritage: Xuan Huong Lake - Bao Dai Palace - Historic Churches
raw_json.terrain_and_road_condition: Fully paved inner-city streets with characteristic gentle slopes, convenient for walking or motorbike.
raw_json.best_vehicle: Motorbike, tandem bicycle, or on foot around the lake

ideal_timing.morning: 08:00 - 11:30: Da Lat Railway Station, Bao Dai Palace I, Palace III, Domaine de Marie Church
ideal_timing.afternoon: 14:00 - 17:00: Lam Vien Square (giant Artichoke & Wild Daisy sculptures), XQ Embroidery Museum
ideal_timing.evening: 18:00 - 22:30: Stroll around Xuan Huong Lake, eat and explore Da Lat Night Market (Hoa Binh Pedestrian Street)

key_places.name: Da Lat Night Market
key_places.activity: Grilled rice paper, hot soy milk, avocado ice cream, roasted sweet potato

key_places.name: Bao Dai Palace I (King Palace)
key_places.activity: Lavish French colonial villa among century-old melaleuca trees

key_places.name: Bao Dai Palace III
key_places.activity: Original living and working quarters of the last Nguyen Dynasty emperor

key_places.name: Da Lat Historic Railway Station
key_places.activity: The oldest rack railway station in Indochina with Langbiang peak roofline architecture

key_places.name: Domaine de Marie Church (Mai Anh)
key_places.activity: Pastel pink Normandie-style church with no bell tower

suggested_half_day_flow: 08:00: Check-in at Da Lat Railway Station, board the vintage steam train to Trai Mat
09:30: Tour Bao Dai Palace I - French aristocratic photo vibes
11:00: Check-in at the pink Domaine de Marie Church
12:00: Lunch - banh uot long ga at Long Chuyen
17:00: Watch the sunset over Xuan Huong Lake and wander the Night Market
raw_json.ai_clustering_rules: Best for the first afternoon/evening upon arriving in Da Lat after check-in, or the last day before heading to the bus station/airport.

name: Lac Duong Corridor: Langbiang - Roof of the Central Highlands & Dung Village

raw_json.cluster_name: Lac Duong Corridor: Langbiang - Roof of the Central Highlands & Dung Village
raw_json.terrain_and_road_condition: Provincial Road 722 is wide and open. The slope up to the Langbiang observation deck is served by dedicated jeeps operated by the park management.
raw_json.best_vehicle: Motorbike/car to the mountain base -> Rent a dedicated jeep to the Radar Summit

ideal_timing.morning: 08:00 - 12:00: Conquer the Radar Peak, panoramic views, trek to Yen Ngua Summit (2,167m)
ideal_timing.evening: 18:30 - 21:00: Attend the Central Highlands Gong Festival at the foot of Langbiang Mountain

key_places.name: Langbiang Mountain Peak (Radar Summit 1,929m)
key_places.activity: Jeep ride to the summit, panoramic view of Lac Duong town and Dankia River

key_places.name: Central Highlands Gong Exchange Festival at Langbiang
key_places.activity: Drink can wine, eat skewered grilled pork around a bonfire, dance with the K'Ho ethnic people

suggested_half_day_flow: 08:00: Drive to the foot of Langbiang Mountain
08:30: Buy a jeep ticket and race up to the Radar Summit (1,929m)
10:00: Listen to the legendary love story of K'Lang and H'Biang
11:30: Enjoy bamboo rice with grilled chicken on Lac Duong hill
raw_json.ai_clustering_rules: Top indigenous cultural highlight for 'Indigenous culture' and 'Adventure' traveler profiles.
